sentence: Yezmer lḥal ad yili Tom yesɛa ayen nniḍen ara yexdem.
credits: Sentence from Tatoeba by LdjuherTaqvaylit (CC-BY 2.0 FR)
translations: Tom may have other things to do.

usageExamples: Yenna-d Tom dakken ur ihegga ara iwakken ad iqleɛ.
Tom said he's not ready to leave.
